newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU flour firms seek 362,000 T for export - officials.
newsitem.headline: EU flour firms seek 362,000 T for export - officials.

text.p: European flour firms applied for some 362,000 tonnes of exports last Thursday with licences carrying a 26.50 Ecus per tonne refund, EU grain officials said on Monday.
The Commission has three working days to decide whether to accept or reject the bids.
In France only traders applied to export some 141,000 tonnes of flour, national grain office ONIC specified.
Trade firms made their bids before the EU's grain committee on Thursday cut the daily refund applying to flour exports to 24.00 Ecus per tonne from a previous level of 26.50 Ecus.
The reduction in the flour refund followed an EU decision to cut the rebate offered on free-market soft wheat exports to 17.47 Ecus per tonne from 19.45 Ecus the previous week.
